title: Saving for a goal
subject: savings option
scope: How long a savings pot takes to reach a goal in Singapore dollars. Type what you have, what you add each month and the target; pick a low, base or high yearly return, or your own.
limits: Returns are Oct 2026 yields and bank rates, which change often; bank 'up to' rates need salary credit and card spend. Interest tax, fees and bond early-redemption rules are ignored. Not advice.

items.name: Bank savings account with bonus interest
items.rateBasis: High: the advertised 'up to' rate for the first S$100,000. Low: you miss some bonus conditions. Base: most of the bonus.
items.notes: Up to 2.20% a year if you credit salary, grow your balance and spend on the card (Aug to Dec 2026 promotion).

items.name: Singapore Savings Bonds
items.rateBasis: Base: the Oct 2026 issue's 10-year average return. Low: the Aug 2026 issue. High: assumes a slightly better future issue.
items.notes: Government-backed; money can be withdrawn any month without penalty.

items.name: 6-month T-bills, rolled over
items.rateBasis: Base: 8 Oct 2026 cut-off of 1.90%. Low: assumes yields fall. High: assumes they rise.
items.notes: Yields reset at every auction, so a long projection is only an assumption.

builtBy: Built by hand with Claude on 27 Oct 2026 to show this template. Figures come from a few web searches, not a full research run: check each source.
